name: StereoGaussians
definition: A feed-forward method that predicts a metric 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representation from a single calibrated stereo pair, enabling nearby-view extrapolation without per-scene optimization.
summary: StereoGaussians predicts metric 3D Gaussian Splatting from a single stereo pair using a two-layer structure and expanded canvas to enable nearby-view extrapolation without per-scene optimization.
